trap.label: interpretar a pergunta
trap.wrong: Discuss about to what extent technology helps.
trap.right: Discuss to what extent technology helps.
trap.why: Por influência de “discutir sobre”, o brasileiro põe about. Em inglês, discuss é seguido direto do objeto.

fix.wrong: I will argue what it works.
fix.right: I will argue that it works.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva sem about: “Talk about the causes in your essay.”
rewrite.answer: Discuss the causes in your essay.

rewrite.prompt: Complete: “I will argue ___ it works.” (frase completa)
rewrite.answer: I will argue that it works.
